ja133:0.4: Like a Fire Consuming Ghee: a past life story
ja133:1.1: “Where it was safe, there an enemy has been roused,
ja133:1.2: a forest fire blazes in the heart of the woods;
ja133:1.3: Today, great earth-grown one, there is no place to stay
ja133:1.4: on the earth or in a tree; let us go in four directions, and today let our refuge be fear.”
ja133:2.1: Like a Fire Consuming Ghee: Third.
